fix: Remove the JWT secret from source and load it from an environment variable or secret manager, then rotate it.
Use a parameterized query such as WHERE title LIKE $1 with ['%' + q + '%'] instead of interpolating q.
Resolve the path, verify it stays under REPORT_DIR (or use sendFile with the root option and a basename), and reject otherwise.
Hash passwords with a salted adaptive algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of unsalted MD5.
Validate req.body.url against an allowlist of hosts/schemes and block internal and link-local addresses before fetching.
Add requireAdmin or an ownership check (AND owner_id = $2) so users can delete only permitted tickets.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate format against an allowlist such as csv/json.
